entities.summary: Sun Jianguo (b. 1952-02-01, Wuqiao County) was a diplomat or ambassador of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Wuqiao County and China. Known in the fields of china, naval commanders, asia.
